analyzedQuery.intent: Find the top 5 branches with the largest revenue decrease when comparing the most recent month to the month before it

history.sqlQuery:
WITH revenue_comparison AS (
  SELECT 
    store_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = 12 THEN net_revenue_tl_month END) as revenue_last_month,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = 11 THEN net_revenue_tl_month END) as revenue_previous_month
  FROM store_metrics
  WHERE year = 2024 AND month IN (11, 12)
  GROUP BY store_name
)
SELECT 
  store_name,
  revenue_previous_month,
  revenue_last_month,
  (revenue_last_month - revenue_previous_month) as revenue_change,
  ROUND(((revenue_last_month - revenue_previous_month) / NULLIF(revenue_previous_month, 0) * 100), 2) as percent_change
FROM revenue_comparison
WHERE revenue_last_month IS NOT NULL AND revenue_previous_month IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY revenue_change ASC
LIMIT 5

history.sqlQuery:
WITH store_revenues AS (
  SELECT 
    store_district,
    store_name,
    SUM(net_revenue_tl_month) as total_revenue
  FROM store_metrics
  WHERE year = 2024
  GROUP BY store_district, store_name
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    store_district,
    AVG(total_revenue) as avg_revenue,
    MAX(total_revenue) as max_revenue,
    MIN(total_revenue) as min_revenue
  FROM store_revenues
  GROUP BY store_district
),
highest_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (store_district)
    store_district,
    store_name as highest_store,
    total_revenue as highest_revenue
  FROM store_revenues
  ORDER BY store_district, total_revenue DESC
),
lowest_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (store_district)
    store_district,
    store_name as lowest_store,
    total_revenue as lowest_revenue
  FROM store_revenues
  ORDER BY store_district, total_revenue ASC
)
SELECT 
  rs.store_district as region,
  ROUND(rs.avg_revenue, 2) as average_revenue,
  hs.highest_store,
  ROUND(hs.highest_revenue, 2) as highest_revenue,
  ls.lowest_store,
  ROUND(ls.lowest_revenue, 2) as lowest_revenue
FROM region_stats rs
JOIN highest_stores hs ON rs.store_district = hs.store_district
JOIN lowest_stores ls ON rs.store_district = ls.store_district
ORDER BY rs.avg_revenue DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    store_name,
    store_type,
    month,
    net_revenue_tl_month
  FROM store_metrics

),
store_type_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    store_type,
    month,
    AVG(net_revenue_tl_month) as avg_type_revenue
  FROM store_metrics
  WHERE year = 2024
  GROUP BY store_type, month
),
store_correlation AS (
  SELECT 
    mr.store_name,
    mr.store_type,
    CORR(mr.net_revenue_tl_month, sta.avg_type_revenue) as correlation_score,
    AVG(mr.net_revenue_tl_month) as avg_revenue
  FROM monthly_revenue mr
  JOIN store_type_avg sta ON mr.store_type = sta.store_type AND mr.month = sta.month
  GROUP BY mr.store_name, mr.store_type
)
SELECT 
  store_name,
  store_type,
  ROUND(correlation_score::numeric, 3) as seasonality_correlation,
  ROUND(avg_revenue::numeric, 2) as avg_monthly_revenue
FROM store_correlation
WHERE correlation_score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY correlation_score DESC
LIMIT 100
